items.name: Elif K.
items.title: Istanbul
items.text: I prepared it as a birthday surprise for my husband. He was amazed to see his photo on the fashiontv magazine cover. Reading the interview section made it even more emotional. It now sits in the most visible spot at home.

items.name: Murat B.
items.title: Istanbul
items.text: I had it made for my graduation. Honestly, I didn't expect my photo to look that good on the cover. When my friends saw it, they genuinely thought I was on the real magazine. The interview part especially impressed everyone.

items.name: Selin T.
items.title: Ankara
items.text: I prepared it for my mother. She couldn't believe it when she saw herself on the fashiontv magazine cover. She reads the interview to everyone she meets. She ended up framing it and hanging it in the living room.

items.name: Ahmet Y.
items.title: Izmir
items.text: I wanted to give my girlfriend a unique surprise. She loved seeing herself on the Fashiontv Magazine cover. She held the interview pages for a long time. It truly was a very special gift.

items.name: Zeynep D.
items.title: New Mother
items.text: We had it made as a memory after our baby was born. It became a very special keepsake we'll open and look at years from now. Seeing our own family on the cover felt truly beautiful.

items.name: Ceren A.
items.title: Bursa
items.text: I prepared it for my father's career anniversary. He was surprised at first, then quietly started reading the interview. He finally said 'I'm keeping this.' That moment made everything worthwhile.

about.heroDesc: Going beyond ordinary photos, we immortalize your memories on a professional magazine cover. Every moment, every story, every person deserves to be on a cover.
about.storyP1: Hatıra Dergi was founded for those who want to give something extraordinary to their loved ones or themselves. Because we believe every special moment deserves more than just a photo.
about.storyP2: Inspired by fashiontv magazine aesthetics, you simply upload your photo and answer our questions — we handle the rest. In minutes, you have a print-ready, professional magazine page.
about.storyP3: Every cover is documented with a unique serial number that belongs only to your moment — just as irreplaceable as the moment itself.
about.quoteText: One day everyone will be famous. We're not waiting for that day to come — we're creating it today.
about.missionText: To enable every individual to document their special moments with professional magazine quality. To create personal and meaningful memories accessible to everyone through technology and design.
about.visionText: To bring the philosophy that "everyone is a cover star" from Turkey to the world. To build a culture where memories don't disappear digitally but become works of art that gain value over time.
about.valuesLede: When designing a platform, we didn't just make a feature list. At every step, we asked: does this truly add value to the user's memory?

values.title: Authenticity
values.text: Every design is documented with a unique serial number. Your moment, your signature.

values.title: Quality
values.text: Every page is carefully prepared with professional magazine layout and print quality.

values.title: Simplicity
values.text: Design your own cover in minutes — no technical knowledge required.

values.title: Emotion
values.text: Beyond a photo: your interview, your words, and the true weight of the moment.

about.timelineP1: Like every great idea, Hatıra Dergi was born from an ordinary need. While wanting to give our loved ones "something different," we realized no platform offered a truly personalized, print-quality product.
about.timelineP2: A small team set out with a big dream. Today, tens of thousands of special moments live in frames, not archives.

timeline.title: The First Idea
timeline.desc: The magazine cover idea came to life while looking for a different surprise for our loved ones.

timeline.title: Platform Launch
timeline.desc: Our first users completed their cover designs and the feedback was promising.

timeline.title: Growth Period
timeline.desc: Thousands of people turned their birthday, graduation, and career memories into covers.

timeline.title: New Features
timeline.desc: The platform expanded with the interview module, advanced templates, and collection pages.

howItWorks.heroDesc: From cover design to interview, from photo upload to PDF — create your own magazine page in four steps. Average completion time: 15 minutes.

steps.cardDesc: Open the editor, upload your photo, and personalize your cover. Background, logo color, text, fonts — everything is in your hands.
steps.title: Design
steps.desc: When you enter the cover editor, a fully equipped design interface awaits you. Upload your photo, choose your background color, set your logo color, and add text to your cover.
bullets: Upload your photo — cover is automatically framed
Choose from 6 background colors (Black, Anthracite, Gray, Cream, White, Gold)
Set logo color (Original, Gold, Silver, Black, Light Blue, Pink)
Add text, drag & drop to position anywhere
Customize text style with 7 different font options

steps.cardDesc: When you finish the cover design, click the Go to Interview button and select the category that best fits your special moment.
steps.title: Go to Interview,
steps.desc: When you finish the cover design, you go directly to the interview section from the editor. Just select the category that best describes your special moment.
bullets: Click the 'Go to Interview' button in the editor
Choose from Birthday, Graduation, Career, Baby, or Wedding categories
Each category comes with its own special questions
Category is selected once and can be changed later

steps.cardDesc: After selecting the category, upload your photo for the interview page.
steps.title: Upload
steps.desc: After selecting the category, you upload a separate photo for your interview page. This photo is used in the interior pages of the magazine.
bullets: Choose a clear and well-lit photo for your interview page
Portrait format photos give the best results
Upload from your phone gallery or computer

steps.cardDesc: Fill in the interview questions specific to your category, and your print-ready PDF is ready.
steps.title: Answer Questions,
steps.desc: Answer the interview questions prepared according to your chosen category. When you're done, your PDF with a unique serial number is instantly ready.
bullets: Answer category-specific questions in your own words
You can skip questions or add new ones
Save as draft and complete later
Download your print-ready PDF with unique serial number

tips.title: Keep Cover Photo Sharp
tips.text: Well-lit, sharp portrait photos give the best cover appearance.

tips.title: Match Background with Logo Color
tips.text: Gold or Silver logo looks great on dark backgrounds. Choose Black logo for light backgrounds.

tips.title: Position Text by Dragging
tips.text: You can drag & drop text to exactly where you want on the cover. Find the most aesthetic layout by trial and error.

tips.title: Choose the Right Category
tips.text: Each category has its own special questions. Choosing the right category makes your interview much more meaningful.

tips.title: Be Honest and Genuine in the Interview
tips.text: Give answers that reflect your true feelings instead of clichés. When you read these pages years later, you'll feel that moment alive.

tips.title: Use the Draft Feature
tips.text: You don't have to finish everything in one session. Save as draft, continue whenever you want.

faqs.q: I made a payment but my account wasn't activated.

faqs.q: Is there a bulk order or corporate package?
